title.en: MALACAÑANG PMS. LIBRARY BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES TRANSFERRING THE INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY OFFICE (IPO) FROM THE OFFICE OF THE EXECUTIVE SECRETARY TO THE DEPARTMENT OF TRADE AND INDUSTRY

text.en:
The Intellectual Property Office (IPO) is hereby transferred from
the Office of the Executive Secretary, and attached to the Department of Trade and

All orders, issuances, rules and regulations or parts thereof
inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 9th day of August in the year of our Lord, two
thousand and four.
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
POMA Hologram « 26953
